title: Aether Protocol
game_overview: Command futuristic strike forces in fast-paced 3D RTS battles across an icy arctic tundra to destroy the enemy command base.
winning_condition: Destroy the enemy command fortress by capturing tactical Aether nodes and deploying advanced battle units.
losing_condition: Your central command fortress is overwhelmed and reduced to zero structural integrity.

controls.action: Select friendly units, interact with tactical UI buttons, or target orbital abilities.
Marquee box select multiple military units across the battlefield.
Issue move or attack orders to selected units towards target coordinates or enemy structures.

controls.input: Q, W, E, R, T Keys / Production Deck Buttons
controls.action: Produce Striker Bots, Artillery Tanks, Raptor Fighters, Atlas Titans, and Aegis Cruisers.
Upgrade technological tier to unlock advanced combat units and army stat multipliers.
Deploy devastating orbital strike weapon upon reaching full satellite charge.
Quickly select all active friendly units on the battlefield.
Instantly pan the camera back to friendly command headquarters.

controls.input: Arrow Keys / Edge Pan / Minimap Drag
controls.action: Pan the tactical isometric camera across the arctic tundra.
Touch buttons for unit deployment, group selection, camera panning, and auto-advance toggle on mobile.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Blitz Tactical Warfare: Rapid 3-8 minute matches with intense macro economy and responsive micro unit control. 2. Arctic Visual Clarity: High-contrast cobalt and crimson mech chassis contrasting against crisp procedural snow dunes, glacial ice, and dynamic blue-tinted shadows. 3. Zero-Lag Procedural Simulation: Pure procedural 3D meshes, custom particle pyrotechnics, and synthesized Web Audio soundscapes running at 60 FPS.
sections.summary: Core architectural principles driving the RTS experience.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player establishes base defense, harvests Aether passively and through 3 contestable capture nodes (North, Center, South), produces combined-arms squads (Strikers, Artillery, Air Fighters, Titans, Battlecruisers), upgrades Tech Tiers, commands tactical assaults, and eliminates the enemy fortress while countering hostile AI incursions and orbital strikes.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Dual Resource & Supply Economy: Influx of Aether and 90-unit cap governing unit manufacturing and tech upgrades. 2. Three-Node Territory Control: Tactical capture radius mechanics accelerating Aether income and Orbital Beam satellite charge. 3. Combined Arms Synergy: Ground biped mechas, heavy splash artillery, high-altitude aerial VTOLs, beam-weapon colossi, and capital dreadnoughts with soft-collision flocking formations. 4. Orbital Superweapon: 900m vertical tactical energy beam dealing area-of-effect destruction on demand.

sections.title: 3D Camera & Movement Alignment
sections.content: 3D Coordinate System: Three.js right-handed coordinate space (+Y is Up, +X is Right/East, -Z is Forward/North, +Z is South). Camera Perspective: Orthographic isometric camera with 4 smooth rotatable quadrant angles, zoom range (0.55x to 2.2x), and target panning. Movement Dynamics: Kinematic flocking with grid formation offsets, soft separation avoidance, ground plane clamping at Y=0, and aerial cruising heights (Y=32 for fighters, Y=58 for cruisers). Asset Alignment: All turrets, mecha chassis, and vehicles author with -Z as primary forward direction.
sections.summary: Rotatable isometric perspective with precise coordinate kinematics.

sections.title: 3D Scene & Environment Structure
sections.content: 3D Scene Separation: High-intensity physical 3-point lighting featuring crisp cool hemisphere sky bounce, directional low-angle morning sunlight casting long blue shadows, and blue rim fill light. Topography: Procedural vertex-elevated terrain with coastal bay depression, rolling wind-swept sastrugi snow dunes, glacial ice patches, dark basalt crags, perimeter pine forests, and persistent scorch craters. Hazard Affordance: Red tactical range rings, pulsing capture node boundaries, and neon laser beam tracers.
sections.summary: Arctic tundra coastal biome with procedural textures and physical lighting.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: Player commands the Aegis Coalition featuring Cobalt Blue armor and regenerative energy shields (+4.8 shield/s). Opposing AI controls the Kronos Dominion featuring Crimson Red chassis and structural regeneration (+HP/s). Unit types include Tier 1 Striker Bots, Manticore/Scorcher Tanks, Raptor/Vulture Air Gunships, Tier 2 Atlas/Omega Titans, and Tier 3 Aegis/Sovereign Battlecruisers. Tactical AI evaluates tech advancement, multi-squad territory capture, and coordinated base assaults across 3 difficulty tiers (Recruit, Commander, Archon).
sections.summary: Asymmetrical faction unit rosters and tactical AI.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: Interactive 2D radar minimap with camera frustum box, floating unit health and shield bars, territory node dominance status lamps, auto-advance rally toggle for newly produced units, and instant Epic Wave sandbox escalation toggle.
sections.summary: Tactical visual assists and status indicators.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Animated weapon barrel recoil, charging orbital reticle glows, and walking cycle torso sway. State Change Juice: Emissive reactor core pulsing, continuous laser beam meshes with twin glowing coronas, and ion engine particle trails. Impact Juice: Screen shake on artillery impact, expanding volumetric fireball spheres, rising carbon smoke columns, and persistent terrain scorch decals paired with synthesized multi-oscillator audio.
sections.summary: High-impact visual and auditory combat feedback.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for real-time strategy enthusiasts. Features combat telemetry timers, kill counters, rank progression (Bronze to Grand Archon), and external leaderboard score submission.
sections.summary: Singleplayer RTS campaign and skirmish progression.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Three selectable lighting profiles (Arctic Tundra, Dusk Glow, High Noon), tactical unit overhead healthbar toggles, full keyboard shortcut support alongside point-and-click/touch interfaces, and master audio mute controls.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Battle.net style Sci-Fi Orbital Terminal Menu -> Skirmish Configuration (Faction, Difficulty, Lighting Mode) -> 3D RTS Battle Arena -> Victory / Defeat Tactical Debriefing with seamless instant rematch capability.
sections.summary: Cohesive battle command UI and state flow.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Mobile HUD featuring bottom-anchored touch production deck with touch-none class, minimap touch panning and waypoint dispatching, floating Auto-Advance and All-Units toggles with pointer-events-auto, and multi-touch box drag selection.
sections.summary: Comprehensive mobile touch layout and gesture handling.
